# awpermit

> Let an agent through your door with a scope, a spend cap, and someone accountable.

Platforms block agents even when they identify themselves, because an admitted agent is unbounded: nothing says what it may do, for whom, or who pays when a web page talks it into something.

## Install

```
pip install git+https://github.com/Aitherium/awpermit
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Mint a permit with a spend cap and watch the platform refuse the purchase over it.

## Composes with

- [awnest](https://aitherium.github.io/awnest/) — Prove there is a human before you let them into the nest.
- [awdit](https://aitherium.github.io/awdit/) — An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.
- [awbac](https://aitherium.github.io/awbac/) — Role-based access control that fails closed and explains itself.
- [awseal](https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/) — Sign an artifact so a stranger can verify it.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awpermit

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awpermit.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.
